parameters.query:
SELECT
  COALESCE(m.status_plano_acao, '')            AS status_anterior,
  COALESCE(CAST(m.produtos_tag AS CHAR), '')   AS produtos_tag,
  COALESCE(CAST(m.dono_do_lead AS CHAR), '')   AS dono_do_lead,
  COALESCE(CAST(m.ultimo_contato AS CHAR), '') AS ultimo_contato,
  COALESCE(CAST(m.id AS CHAR), '')             AS mailing_id
FROM (SELECT 1) base
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT *
  FROM mailing
  WHERE whatsapp IN (
    "{{ (() => { const raw = String($('When Executed by Another Workflow').first().json.phone || ''); let p = raw.replace(/\D/g,''); if (p.startsWith('55')) p = p.slice(2); const ddd = p.slice(0,2); const num = p.slice(2); const com9 = num.length === 8 ? '9' + num : num; return com9.length === 9 ? `(${ddd}) ${com9.slice(0,5)}-${com9.slice(5)}` : `(${ddd}) ${com9.slice(0,4)}-${com9.slice(4)}`; })() }}",
    "{{ (() => { const raw = String($('When Executed by Another Workflow').first().json.phone || ''); let p = raw.replace(/\D/g,''); if (p.startsWith('55')) p = p.slice(2); const ddd = p.slice(0,2); const num = p.slice(2); const sem9 = (num.length === 9 && num.startsWith('9')) ? num.slice(1) : num; return `(${ddd}) ${sem9.slice(0,4)}-${sem9.slice(4)}`; })() }}"
  )
  ORDER BY id DESC
  LIMIT 1
) m ON 1 = 1;
